incidents.name: PresaleBEP20 public set(address) withdrawal redirect
incidents.notes: PresaleBEP20.set(address) is public and deposit() enforces its 100 BNB cap only per msg.sender while forwarding deposits straight to the mutable withdrawAddress, so the attacker redirected withdrawals to itself and recycled a 100 WBNB flash loan through 70 fresh depositors.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x760C2aAa22220f24B9343b2a91A62dD664953853 created 2021-04-14T09:12:04Z by 0xd54a14ad4edc542709504a8f8e6b790843b2a664, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xc49f2938327aa2cdc3f2f89ed17b54b3671f05de; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 1.921686798824852706 WBNB x $645.48/BNB at the incident timestamp 1747671130 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $1,240, plus 46.47 BUSD at 1:1 = $1,287 total.
